annotations.text: The renderer. It holds the camera, decides the level of detail from the zoom, and replays one recorded picture per file instead of redrawing the geometry.
Reads the repo once and lays every file out by directory. Nothing here knows about drawing: it produces positions and line classifications, and that is all.
A note is anchored to a symbol plus the lines around it, never to a line number. This is what survives the file being edited underneath it.
Boards are one JSON file each so two people editing different boards never conflict.
Images are re-encoded on the way in. A pasted screenshot is megabytes of raw clipboard data, and it would sit in git forever at that size.
